background.comment: The design's #0c0e15, moved dE 0.22. At the design value: the sheet lifts off the frame, measured dE 2.96 >= 3.

pressed.comment: A step the kit draws from surface-hover: the design draws no pressed row; a press is a stronger hover. At that value: a pressed row is visible over a hovered one, measured dE 0.00 >= 3 from a hovered row on it.

tertiary.comment: The design's #8a91a6, moved dE 2.55. At the design value: text step clears its floor, measured 4.10:1 >= 4.5, worst on a pressed row on raised; text on glass clears 4.5:1, measured 4.47:1.

hatch.comment: The arranging hatch's line: strong at 60% over the sheet. A board under construction draws its diagonals in it, and so does a note standing on that board, which is why it is a colour of its own and not the strong border faded on a layer.

control.comment: The design's #6a7186, moved dE 3.00. At the design value: a control boundary clears 3:1, measured 2.65:1, worst on a pressed row on raised.

field.comment: The strong border, #2b3245, lightened dE 19.48: the least move that clears 3:1 on every rung a text field sits on (3.00:1 on the raised rung, the worst). A field stands on a rung and never inside a hovered or pressed row, so it is held to the rungs alone rather than to the composites the control boundary clears, and it reads as quietly as a secondary button's edge allows.

focus.comment: A step the kit draws from brand-accent: the ring is drawn in the accent. At that value: the focus ring clears 3:1, measured 2.72:1, worst on a pressed row on raised.

warning.comment: The design's #f0b429, moved dE 0.17. At the design value: status hues stay separable, measured dE n20.3/p9.8/d15.8 >= 10.

danger.comment: The design's #f0506e, moved dE 6.47. At the design value: a label clears 4.5:1 on its own fill, measured 3.46:1, worst on feedback-danger on the frame; status hues stay separable, measured dE n34.5/p18.6/d5.9 >= 10; no data hue collides with danger, measured dE n12.5/p11.7/d8.3 >= 14 normal, 8 dichromat.

dangerHover.comment: A step the kit draws from feedback-danger: a step of the danger fill: the design draws no hover for the destructive action. At that value: a hovered destructive action is a visible step away from its label, measured dE 0.00 >= 3, and text-on-danger 4.50:1 -> 4.50:1 rises.
